member.name: T:Ethar.GeoPose.Authority.Ogc.OgcConstants
member.summary: Identifiers used by the OGC GeoPose 1.0 example instances (https://schemas.opengis.net/geopose/1.0/instances/).
member.remarks: The standard leaves authority strings, frame ids and parameter grammar to each authority. The OGC's own instance files, which the conformance test suite and other implementations use, all carry the authority /geopose/1.0 and the ids and grammar below. implements that authority so those files, and payloads from implementations that follow them, can be exchanged with this library.

member.name: T:Ethar.GeoPose.Authority.Ogc.OgcGeoPoseAuthority
member.summary: The /geopose/1.0 authority: reads and writes the frame specifications and transition models exactly as the OGC GeoPose 1.0 example instances encode them, so that those files and payloads from other implementations can be exchanged with this library.

remarks.para: Grammar, taken from https://schemas.opengis.net/geopose/1.0/instances/: LTP frames carry longitude=…&latitude=…&height=… (height above the WGS 84 ellipsoid), and translate-rotate frames carry translation=[x, y, z]&rotation=[w, x, y, z]. The rotation array is w-first, as the standard's prose lists the components; the JSON quaternion member of the Basic and Advanced targets is x-first. Numbers are culture-invariant.
Register with AuthorityProvider.RegisterAuthority(new OgcGeoPoseAuthority()), or call to register it together with the Ethar authority.
